column1: # Path selection rules for runner-1001/select-lanes.py: which manifest rows a changed path touches.
# glob: with a "/", the whole repo-relative path ("*" stays in one folder, "**" crosses folders); without, the file name
#   at any depth; a leading "/" anchors a file name at the repo root. Every matching rule counts (their steps are unioned).
# targets: lane:NAME (lane:* = every lane) | step:GLOB | config:C | own (rows whose `file` matches) | uses (rows whose
#   runner command, check file or loaded scripts/ helper names the path; an app file reaches every APP-recipe step) |
#   all (the full rc tier) | none (nothing reads it).
# A path no rule selects a row for falls back to the full rc tier. The builds are always selected.
